item.title: Africa's Deadliest Predators: 2 Hours of Real Kill-or-Be-Killed Encounters
item.description:
Made with Restream Studio. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io
Two hours inside the most dangerous stretch of wilderness on Earth — where every encounter comes down to one rule: kill or be killed.
This compilation brings together our most intense predator confrontations from across the Apex Files and Africa's Hierarchy series: lions, crocodiles, leopards, hyenas, and the honey badger that's outlasted all of them. Real footage, real behavior, no dramatization beyond what the science supports.
🎬 Full episodes referenced in this compilation: Honey Badger Wars series Lion vs Crocodile Files Crocodile vs Black Mamba
